tools.name: images_generate
tools.description: Generate or edit an image. Put the pictures to edit or follow in images, chosen by you: conversation images by their exact log:/mem: handle, and visual library pictures as mem:visual/<id>/<file> (only the ones that fit the request, e.g. just the default look when asked for it). For visual library pictures the description of that entry is attached too. Returns a blob, NOT a sent message: use the current channel send tool afterward. For existing memes use search_meme.

images.description: Picture handles in the order you refer to them in the prompt: log:/mem: conversation images and mem:visual/<id>/<file>; omit when none.
